verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio lets users build verification workflows with a no-code, drag-and-drop builder. Once a workflow run is created, results arrive asynchronously through webhooks or polling, so verification processing happens in the background without manual steps. However, these are applicant-triggered verification flows rather than general-purpose autonomous automations, and the evidence does not show scheduling, recurring jobs or agent-driven background tasks. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring background automations, autonomous triggers not tied to an applicant session, ongoing re-check automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
